headline: Your buyers will spend three days at CloudSec Expo. The evening before it opens is still free.
standfirst: A one-page read of the week from public pages, for the team running Acme's presence. Where your buyers will be, what already competes for their evenings, and one way to use the week better. Everything only you know is left blank for you.

question.label: Machine identities
question.question: How are you governing machine identities, now that they outnumber your people?
question.why: It has its own session on day 1, and it runs through the identity track.

suggestion.title: A private table on the evening before the show
suggestion.body: Twelve people from your Tier 1 accounts, the evening before the floor opens, away from the venue, on the machine identity question. Nothing is announced against that evening, and it does not compete with the breakfast you already sponsor the next morning.
suggestion.timing: With about seven weeks to go, a full table is tight: each person is approached individually, and that takes about six weeks. If you want it this year, the decision belongs in October. If not, it belongs on next year's calendar, and your own breakfast is where this year's conversations start.
suggestion.status: You can run it with your own team, and we can plan it with you now. Approaching guests on your behalf opens once our privacy position is written.
